name: employeeLeaveApplication
description:
To generate the leave approver's details, follow this exact sequence. First, execute EmployeeDetails to retrieve basic employee information. Then execute EmployeeLogKey to obtain the employee's login key. Next, execute GetEmployeeLeaveBalance to fetch available leave balances.
When the user selects a leave type (e.g., "Annual Leave"), internally retrieve the corresponding leaveTypeCode and leaveGroupCode — never ask the user to input or view any codes. Then execute this tool to fetch the approver's details.
After identifying the leave type, check IsCommentMandatory from the selected leave type response: if 1, a comment is required and submission must not proceed without it; if 0, don't mention as comment required. This rule may vary by client and leave type, so never hardcode it.
If the user specifies a covering employee, allow search by name or code and use getEmpDetails to resolve the coveringEmployeeCode.
Never display group codes, leave type codes, or employee keys to the user.

args.name: leaveTypeCode
args.description: to get the leave type is "getEmployeeLeaveBalance" api. user give leave type name corresponding leave Type Code will be Example:"000001", do not ask the user for leave type code.

args.description: user to give the leave from date. Example:"09/04/24" - must should take in this date format "dd/mm/yy"

args.description: user to give the leave to date. Example:"09/04/24"- must should take in this date format "dd/mm/yy"

args.name: coveringEmployeeCode
args.description: in this argument is optional field but if the user added the covering employee to search employee name or code if the user search name corresponding id take Ex:"000002" for execute api is getCoveringEmployee Api.

args.name: year
args.description: user provide the year example 2025,2024 etc.

args.name: dayMode
args.description: if the user to ask leave mode like Whole Day means 1 ,First Half means 0.5, Second Half means 0.5 and Off Day means 0.0 user selected leave mode name corresponding value will be take, and display the names, no display the values.
